football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.8 points.
supporting: When Western Michigan has the ball (big plays on the ground): Western Michigan’s offense turns 5.1% of its runs into explosive gains, and Central Michigan’s defense gives up explosive gains on 5.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Central Michigan has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Central Michigan’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 11.7% of its runs, and Western Michigan’s defense stops 15.7% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
In his last two games (Akron and Ohio), Flores averaged 5.6 yards per attempt, against 3.7 in his four games before that.
In his last two games (Akron and Ohio), Glasser averaged 20.7 yards per attempt, against 3.9 in his three games before that.
contradicting: When Central Michigan has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Central Michigan’s offense has allowed a sack on 12.6% of its dropbacks, and Western Michigan’s defense sacks the quarterback on 7.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Central Michigan has the ball (big plays through the air): Central Michigan’s offense turns 4.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Western Michigan’s defense gives up explosive gains on 10.7% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.4%).

When Central Michigan has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Central Michigan’s offense averages 5.1 yards per pass attempt, and Western Michigan’s defense allows 7.4 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.5).

When Central Michigan has the ball (third down): Central Michigan’s offense converts 31.6% of its third downs, and Western Michigan’s defense allows opponents to convert 35.4% of their third downs (FBS average 39.5%).
quarterbacks: Angel Flores has completed 40 of 67 passes (59.7%) for 313 yards, 4.7 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and 2 interceptions in six games for Central Michigan, and has been sacked on 8 of 75 dropbacks.
Jadyn Glasser has completed 22 of 36 passes (61.1%) for 257 yards, 7.1 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and 2 interceptions in five games for Central Michigan, and has been sacked on 5 of 41 dropbacks.
Broc Lowry has completed 96 of 139 passes (69.1%) for 993 yards, 7.1 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 1 interception in six games for Western Michigan, and has been sacked on 8 of 147 dropbacks.
